title: VACUUM CONTROL HOSE ROUTING
summary: Routing of the vacuum line from the heater control (control asm.) back to the valve and actuator at the rear of the cockpit, all models. A metal vacuum pipe runs along the rear compartment behind the seats in clips riveted to the body; hoses join it to the valve/actuator, routed up the rear window pillar on coupes and along the lock pillar on convertibles. Hose ends are retained on the valves with clips.

fastening.note: Views B and C: clip [1] holds the end of hose [2] on the valve asm. or actuator nipple. [A] Typical 2 places.
View A (typical attachment): rivet [7] goes through the hole in clip [4] into a hole in the body panel; clip [4] wraps around the pipe/hose.
Main view: rivet [5] fastens the clip [4] at the left (lock-pillar) end of pipe [3].

fastening.to: rear compartment floor/rear wall behind seats
fastening.note: Main view: clips [4] carry pipe [3] across the car behind the seats. Clip spacing dims 10.50 and 11; .387 to the pipe.
Main view and View B (convertible only): clip [6] holds hose [2] along the lock pillar on the convertible routing.
Coupe routing: hose [2] and pipe [3] run up beside the rear window held by clips (see UPC 12), not numbered on this sheet.

notes: NOTE: Bend & route vacuum pipe between insulation & lock pillar support brace as shown.
